summary: When the fleet GitHub plugin read test's mirror wait runs out, it now says which step the poller stopped at: the read's source and reason, the looks its observer recorded, its last observer state and its log tail. This diagnoses a flake (#4470). Test-only change.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no replay or stored data changes.

compatibility.detail: No runtime compatibility change; the product is unchanged.

recovery.detail: No persisted state or recovery change.
